userGoal: Obtain actual four-case results and preserve real failures while keeping all original 74 acceptance criteria.

alternatives.name: minimal-local-sentinel-repair-and-closed-guard-facts
alternatives.benefit: Correct the proven same-version false/undefined mismatch without another diagnostic run; preserve which context/reporter predicate actually rejects in existing private error output.
alternatives.cost: A separate successor driver source, one necessary targeted pure group and independent source review are required.

alternatives.name: additional-onsite-context-only-diagnostic-before-any-repair
alternatives.benefit: Could observe actual context predicate values in a separately qualified future diagnostic.
alternatives.cost: Adds new onsite preparation and a remote operation despite an already proven sufficient source incompatibility.

implementationScope.fix: Use the pinned resolved undefined sentinel for disabled file loading and also require empty configFileDependencies; retain explicitly disabled inline input and the other eight context/reporter conditions.
implementationScope.diagnostics: Preserve first rejected context/reporter condition using only fixed literal condition names and boolean or not-evaluated values in the existing private driver failure report; preserve short circuit and primary error order. Do not store context objects, internal tokens, values, paths, Env or error bodies in public output.
implementationScope.kept: API guard and other normalized-config predicates, plugins, 13 modules and 12-host+1-deferred contract, original callbacks/hooks/SQL/fixture, freshness, limits, failure/close/private retention and public protocols remain unchanged.
implementationScope.validation: One new targeted pure group only; no framework, fixture, candidate, old groups, remote calls or model runs.

rollbackCondition: Reject successor source or entry if exact inverse, retained gates, closed diagnostics or targeted validation fails; preserve all originals and do not dispatch.
